token.description: API token with ingest and query on the datasets

publicIp.description: KEEL_PUBLIC_IP, null when this install does not know it

deploy.description: Ship it right away (skipped when a deployment is already running)

engine.description: Databases and caches: picks image and port

name.description: Omitted or empty: named after the engine or image, made unique

position.description: Omitted: right of the rightmost top-level node

name.description: 1–60 characters after trimming; the slug is derived from it

appliedAt.description: When Swarm took the new spec

nodeId.description: Absent on the final health checks step

steps.description: One per shipped node in canvas order, then health checks

deployment.description: null when there is none or it is not yours

error.description: authorization_pending, slow_down, expired_token, access_denied, invalid_grant, invalid_client, invalid_request, unauthorized, unsupported_grant_type, server_error

task.description: Swarm task id; empty when unknown

time.description: Epoch ms, fractional; 0 when the line had no stamp

counts.description: Derived status per node (groups excluded, volumes count as pending); zero counts are absent

pendingChanges.description: Deployable nodes with a staged change

summary.description: null when the environment is missing or not the caller's

domain.description: http only: your own hostname, pointed at the control plane's public IP. Default: an sslip.io name

port.description: Container port the proxy dials. Default: the node's port

protocol.description: Default: http for a service, tcp for a database or cache

publicPort.description: tcp/udp only: port on the control plane. Default: the container port when free, else the first free from 20000

sink.description: null when the organization has no sink (Docker default)

organization.description: null until the account is in the install's organization

siteUrl.description: Dashboard URL as users open it

startedAt.description: When the current revision shipped (unix ms)

dirty.description: Has a staged change (the CLI's staged)

parentId.description: The group it is in; position is then relative to it

orgs.description: null when no sign-in waits for an org pick

title.description: Short summary of the problem type

type.description: A URI reference identifying the problem type

project.description: null when missing or not in the caller's organization

provided.description: Computed (DATABASE_URL, REDIS_URL, URL, HOST, PORT), not a row

keys.description: Provided keys first (URL key, HOST, PORT), then the node's rows

sources.description: Every other deployable node of the environment, in creation order

task.description: Swarm task id; empty when unknown

time.description: Epoch ms, fractional; 0 when the line had no stamp

previousKey.description: Rename that row to key instead of upserting; references follow

only.description: Node ids to deploy; absent = every node with staged changes

open.description: True until the first account exists; later sign-ups need an invitation

invitationId.description: The id from an invite link; required once the first account exists

kind.description: server, client, internal, producer, consumer or empty

deploymentId.description: null when it already was at 0 replicas

buckets.description: Every bucket, oldest first, empty ones included

overridden.description: The service's own variables replace this one

tracing.description: null when the node is not a service the caller can see

config.description: Volume size, group box; omitted fields keep their value

name.description: Rename; references to the node follow

parentId.description: A group's id, or "" for the top level; the node keeps its place unless position is given

position.description: With parentId: the position inside the new parent

variables.description: In row (creation) order: the container Env order

resolved.description: References expanded: what the container gets

resolvedSecret.description: A referenced value is secret: mask resolved

secret.description: The row's own flag: mask value

value.description: As typed; may contain ${{ node.KEY }} references
